# Bundled synthesizer runtime

This directory contains the Linux x86-64 binaries used by the training bundle:

- Dexed `618b318792e74386b7afc910d1365827e770222e`
  ([corresponding source](https://github.com/asb2m10/dexed/tree/618b318792e74386b7afc910d1365827e770222e)),
  distributed under GPL-3.0. See `Dexed/LICENSE`.
- RenderMan `e81510d8b564a100899f4fed8c3049c8812cba8d`
  ([corresponding source](https://github.com/fedden/RenderMan/tree/e81510d8b564a100899f4fed8c3049c8812cba8d)),
  released into the public domain. See `RenderMan/LICENSE`.

The binaries are tracked with Git LFS. Run `git lfs pull` after cloning if
your Git client did not retrieve them automatically.
